headline: Campo Trión advances with investment of 10,434 million dollars in Tamaulipas
summary: Tamaulipas state's economy secretary said the Campo Trión project, with an investment of $10.434 million, aims to link local firms with large investments in the state. The project is advancing.
why: Large industrial investments in Mexican states affect regional employment, supplier opportunities and foreign direct investment flows.
original_headline: Campo Trión avanza con inversión de 10,434 millones de dólares en Tamaulipas
